method: All canonical names reviewed; editorial transliteration of brands/proper names, conventional local place names and translated descriptive qualifiers. Original English retained where local spelling is uncertain. No broadcaster-authenticated translations claimed.

manualReview.name: Aural Radio Kerala
manualReview.reason: Publisher-preferred pronunciation and Tamil/Devanagari spelling of Aural need confirmation.

manualReview.name: mauRadio
manualReview.reason: Stylized mauRadio brand pronunciation and word boundary need confirmation.

manualReview.name: JEIFM
manualReview.reason: JEIFM acronym expansion/pronunciation is not established; preserve original brand.

manualReview.name: Otran Vaanoli
manualReview.reason: Tamil consonant and vowel spelling of Otran is ambiguous from Latin text.

manualReview.name: Radio Norge
manualReview.reason: Norwegian brand pronunciation needs native/local-script review.

manualReview.name: SuomiPop
manualReview.reason: Finnish compound brand needs native/local-script review.

manualReview.name: Znad Wilii
manualReview.reason: Polish brand pronunciation and Lithuanian place association require review.

manualReview.name: Radio Stad Den Haag
manualReview.reason: Dutch brand/place pronunciation needs native/local-script review.

manualReview.name: Sveriges Radio P1
manualReview.reason: Swedish brand pronunciation needs native/local-script review; preserve P1.

manualReview.name: Radio dla Dorosłych
manualReview.reason: Polish consonant clusters and diacritics need native/local-script review.

manualReview.name: Nagham FM Egypt
manualReview.reason: Arabic brand consonant/vowel representation needs native/local-script review.

manualReview.name: 77H FM Guarujá SP
manualReview.reason: Brazilian Guarujá pronunciation needs review; retain exact 77H and SP identifiers.

manualReview.name: Vaalai FM
manualReview.reason: Vaalai has several possible Tamil consonant/vowel spellings; do not guess.

manualReview.name: Sree Kurumba FM
manualReview.reason: Publisher-preferred spelling of the Kurumba proper name needs confirmation.

manualReview.name: Kanal Music
manualReview.reason: Kanal can represent distinct Tamil words; do not choose a meaning/spelling without confirmation.

manualReview.name: Kandhakapookkal Radio
manualReview.reason: Publisher-preferred compound consonant/vowel spelling needs confirmation.
